dct_title_s: UNOSAT Gaza Strip Comprehensive Damage Assessment 1km Stretch of Land from the Armistice Demarcation Line - April 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: CE20231007PSE** This map illustrates a satellite-imagery based comprehensive damage assessment (CDA) to detect damage and destruction within a stretch of land 1 km from the Armistice Demarcation Line in the Gaza Strip, Occupied Palestinian Territory. This analysis includes a CDA from several dates, including 15 October 2023, 7 November 2023, 26 November 2023, 7 January 2024 and 29 February 2024. Statistical analysis shows the rapid increase in damaged and destroyed buildings within the zone, from 15% to 90% between October 2023 and February 2024. Satellite-derived analysis undertaken on 29 February 2024 on 4042 buildings within the zone, shows 3033 destroyed, 593 damaged (severe or moderately) and 416 with no visible damage.
